   - "Screening of cervical spine shows focal reversal of lordosis from C3-C6 vertebrae."

   - Explicitly specify Modic type and signal characteristics: "Modic type 2 changes (hyperintense on both T1 and T2 weighted images) are seen involving the adjacent endplates of L5 and S1 vertebrae."
   - "Modic type 1 changes (hypointense on T1 and hyperintense on T2/STIR weighted images, suggestive of active inflammatory edema) are seen..."

   - Annular Tear: "Annular tear with pseudo bulge of L5-S1 disc causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."
   - Disc Desiccation: "There is loss of normal T2 hyperintensity of L4-L5 and L5-S1 discs suggestive of disc desiccation."
   - Posterior Concavity: "Loss of normal posterior concavity of L4-L5 disc is seen causing no significant mass effect."
   - Herniation Spectrum: "Diffuse annular disc bulge with central and left central disc extrusion with inferior migration is noted at L5-S1 level resulting in severe secondary canal narrowing, compression of left traversing nerve root and compression of the left half of the thecal sac and its contents."
   - Facet Arthropathy: "Mild to moderate bilateral facetal arthropathy is noted at L4-L5 and L5-S1 levels with ligamentum flavum thickening."
4. Listhesis & Spondylolysis:
   - "Grade 1 anterolisthesis of L5 over S1 with bilateral pars interarticularis defect (spondylolysis) causing unroofing of the disc, secondary canal narrowing and indenting bilateral exiting nerve roots."

   - "The conus medullaris ends at upper border of L1 and the cauda equina is normal in appearance."
   - "Screening of cervical spine shows bilateral uncovertebral joint arthropathy at C5-C6 causing bilateral neural foraminal narrowing."
   - "Screening of dorsal spine shows hemangioma of D10 and D11 vertebral bodies."
